options.label: System
options.help: Follows whatever your operating system is set to.

options.label: OLED
options.help: Pure black on dark, pure white on light. Maximum contrast.

options.label: Graphite
options.help: Neutral greys with the blue cast removed.

options.label: Ember
options.help: Warm browns under a copper accent.

options.label: Nocturne
options.help: Violet surfaces with a matching violet accent.

options.label: Wordmark
options.help: Draws the name as text in the theme’s own colours. Pages with a game theme keep their own logo.

options.label: Floating
options.help: Puts the buff icons back in the top-left corner so they no longer take up page height.

features.label: Flat background
features.help: Drops the faint game pattern behind the page.
